answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 62 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in inlet, queued in walnut, and hollow publishes the wait time. A farm of 269 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3648 identities would post 2770 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
